resources.string: Skills, persona or model settings have changed. The saved summary cannot be reused. Review the original conversation, then send a message below to continue the task with the current settings and original history. Tool safety checks and cumulative task limits still apply; a new summary may be needed.
Summaries may lose details. Check the original conversation and tool results before continuing. Existing approvals and cumulative task limits still apply.

Use only a context window verified for this model. This path does not generate a summary or change the model. It preserves the original messages, approvals and cumulative limits; the request can still be rejected or paused.
Confirmation is unavailable for an unattended task or when its original identity cannot be verified. No request will be retried automatically.
Enter 1,024–1,000,000 tokens. Larger-window retry requires a value greater than the current window. This setting does not increase the provider’s actual capacity.
